Description: A trauma shears and scalpel kit, the scalpel the sharpest thing in it. Better than nothing.
A nine millimetre pistol from the security office. It fires handgun bullets.
The security office's pump shotgun. It throws a creature off its feet.
Rounds for the handgun.
Shells for the shotgun.
A .44 revolver the RA confiscated and never handed in. It throws anything off its feet.
Heavy rounds for the magnum.
The Guardsman's grenade launcher, a single-shot break action. It fells anything.
40mm grenades for the launcher.
A tube of antiseptic gel and a dressing. It eases wounds a little.
A vial of clotting agent. Useless alone - but mixed with antiseptic its power grows.
Two dressings with antiseptic. They ease wounds a good deal.
Antiseptic and coagulant on a dressing. It heals wounds entirely.
A spray that heals wounds entirely.
A typewriter ribbon. One ribbon saves once.
A key on a green tag marked PHARMACY.
A heavy key on a black tag marked B-MORGUE.
A big ceramic cartridge fuse for the emergency generator.
The keys to Unit 9. The surgeon's hand was still closed on them.
A Waverly State ID card on a lanyard - D. Okafor. The dorm's doors still read it.
The RA's master key on a red Hollis Hall fob.
Keys to the campus facilities van. They were clipped to the linebacker's belt.
Long-handled bolt cutters from Ray's locker. They'd bite through a padlock's chain.
The foreman's keycard - G. BRANDT, LINE SUPERVISOR. It's still furred with frost.
The freight elevator's key on a red plastic tag. It came out of the sow.
